description: List persistent anonymous speaker UUIDs and the exact registry_revision. Works after microphone close or restart. profile_available=false means provisional continuity, not a recognized person. display_label is optional metadata, never authentication. Copy the exact UUID and revision into speaker.associate for operator-confirmed naming; do not invent either.

session_id.description: Optional exact current session ID; omit to inspect the durable registry without an open microphone.
